messages:
maria: Quick heads-up: onboarding customer Apex LoRA into base v2.3. Did a tiny AWQ4 smoke and saw cents dropped in invoice extraction (example below). Sharing short metrics.

sam: Share numbers and a failing example?

maria: Smoke summary:
- ppl delta (4bit vs fp16): +2.9
- avg digit token logprob shift: -0.95
- exact cents (N=120): 87% -> 70%

Failing prompt:
```
Prompt: "Invoice total: USD 3,210.75"
FP16 -> "3,210.75"
AWQ4 -> "3,210.7"
```

tejas: Likely quant noise on numeric tokens. Can we try softmerge (per-layer float residuals) on last decoder layers and a re-quant with smaller block_size?

maria: Baseline AWQ config used:
```
quant: awq
bits: 4
block_size: 128
per_channel: true
```

sam: I'll run two quick experiments on a 10-case subset: (A) softmerge whitelist layers 10-11 residual_scale=0.02, (B) awq4 block_size=32 symmetric. Drop subset+tar to /tmp and I can run.

maria: Uploaded subset: https://internal-storage.apex/invoice-smoke-10.json and model: https://s3.redwood/models/apex/merged-v2.3-awq4.tar.gz

ci-bot: ci:quick-smoke started (job 8472).

sam: Local quicks: baseline 6/10, softmerge 9/10, block32 7/10. Softmerge reduces numeric logprob shift to ~-0.3.

tejas: Good. Softmerge adds small float patches so expect ~3-5% token latency increase; verify p95.

maria: Request: canary softmerge at 0.5% on Dedicated for 12h, monitor exact_cents, token_latency, p95. If stable, recommend awq4-softmerge for Apex merges and add eval assert exact_cents >= 0.88 to apex-invoice pack.

sam: I'll land canary config and post 6h telemetry.

ben: I'll prep CS note for opt-in.

ci-bot: ci:quick-smoke (job 8472) passed.
